question: What contract terms (initial length and any renewal or extension options) do the deferred compensation / 457 plan recordkeeping RFPs in the corpus propose?
gold_answer: Delaware (OST, 2021): original term five years, with three one-year extension options at OST's discretion subject to Board approval. Clark County, WA (RFP 955): three years, January 1, 2027 to December 31, 2029, extendable for up to seven additional years in one-year increments; terminable by the County on 30 days’ written notice if, solely in its judgment, contract requirements are not being met satisfactorily. Monroe County, NY: contract(s) of up to five years per NY Regulations Section 9003.5(a), cancellable at the end of any contract year on 30 days' notice. Temple City, CA: term to be negotiated at the conclusion of the RFP; firms may price different term structures.
acceptance: The question asks initial terms and renewal/extension options. Termination rights are optional; a correct answer omitting termination is fully acceptable. Clark’s 5/7/10-year pricing template does not replace its explicit 3+7 period clause.
candidate_answer:
The four deferred-compensation/457 administration and recordkeeping RFPs propose different contract terms:

| RFP | Initial term | Renewal or extension options |
|---|---|---|
| [Temple City, California](Temple_City_CA__Recordkeeping-RFP.pdf#page=3) | **Not fixed in the RFP**; to be negotiated after selection. | Vendors are asked to price **5-, 7-, and 10-year** scenarios, but the RFP warns that purchasing rules may limit the initial term to five years. Seven- and ten-year pricing assumes a later extension, **not a guaranteed extension**. [Pricing questions](Temple_City_CA__Recordkeeping-RFP.pdf#page=47) |
| [Delaware](Delaware__TRE21101-RECDKEEPR-rfp.pdf#page=2) | **Five years**, with the start date to be determined. | **Three one-year options**, exercisable at the Office of the State Treasurer’s discretion, subject to necessary Board approval. |
| [Monroe County, New York](Monroe_County_NY__10406.pdf#page=6) | **Up to five years**. | **No renewal option is specified.** The committee may cancel at the end of any contract year with 30 days’ written notice; after expiration or termination, it must follow the applicable procedures for awarding a new contract. |
| [Clark County, Washington](Clark_County_WA__-rfp-955-deferred-compensation-457-plan-administrator.pdf#page=8) | **Three years**, intended to run January 1, 2027–December 31, 2029. | Up to **seven additional one-year extensions** (potentially ten years total), by written notice before expiration. Extension costs are reviewed beforehand; other terms and conditions remain the same. |
